audit.scope: Repository source audit only; hosted policies and external infrastructure were not inspected.

current_state.product: Planner OS / Planner Dash event planning operating system

backend.primary_runtime: Next.js route handlers using Node runtime

current_behavior: Matrix 2 is the active Run of Show command center.
Board/List views share the same MatrixRow-backed snapshot.
Board session cards expose a quick action launcher for Basics, Speakers, AV, F&B, Staffing, Room Set, Seating, Conflicts, and full workspace.
Session Quick Change drawer is status-first: basic fields at top, module status cards, compact quick panels for Speakers, AV, F&B, and Staffing only.
Room Set and Seating actions open the full session Room Set workspace modes rather than inline quick editors.
canonical_data: Speaker and SessionSpeakerAssignment own speaker directory assignment.
SessionRequirementTemplate/Section/Item/Selection own AV, F&B, Staffing, setup, and status requirement selections.
EventFnbCatalogItem and SessionFnbCatalogAssignment own canonical F&B catalog/menu assignment.
EventPerson and SessionStaffAssignment own staffing/person assignment.

current_behavior: Room Set is the rich layout workspace for a Run of Show session.
Seating is embedded as a session-scoped mode in the Room Set workspace.
Seating writes can be scoped by matrixRowId/seatingPlanId and support exact chair assignment via seatIndex.
Budget line items, submissions, approval/rejection/revision, reporting, import/export, and budget file flows are implemented.
F&B catalog assignments can sync to budget line items.
Document upload/presign/finalize, versioning, review submit/pull-back, approve/reject/reopen, categories, download, and link options are implemented.
Speaker portal/intake, files, documents, messages, notes, reminders, onsite information, readiness, activity, and read-only planner preview are implemented in source.
Speaker session assignment integrates with Matrix 2 sessions.
Timeline items and dependencies exist with event-scoped service access checks.

speakers: public speaker intake and portal token routes
budget_documents_timeline: Budget, document, timeline item, and timeline dependency API route families remain implemented under /api/events/:eventId/*.

auth_and_authorization.request_user_resolution: resolveRequestUser and ensureProvisionedUserAndContext resolve authenticated app users, org context, and PlatformAdmin context.
event_visibility: SUPER_ADMIN can view across organizations and may use Platform Admin context switching.
OWNER and ADMIN can list organization events.
MEMBER and VIEWER event visibility depends on EventMember rows.
EventMemberRole.EVENT_VIEWER is read-only for guarded event writes.
auth_and_authorization.event_access_helper: assertEventAccessForUser(eventId, user, read|write) centralizes event read/write authorization.
auth_and_authorization.route_guard_coverage: Partial but broadening. Matrix 2 snapshot reads, Matrix speaker assignment writes, seating snapshot/assign/unassign, speaker services, budget services, docs review routes, timeline services, and platform routes use server-side auth/access checks. Some Matrix 2 session, requirement, and F&B assignment routes are not yet uniformly wrapped with request-user/event-access guards.
auth_and_authorization.platform_admin: SUPER_ADMIN-only platform routes use a canonical Platform Admin gate; normal org users continue through org membership and event access paths.

schema_guardrail.rule: No schema changes without rationale, migration plan, data/backfill review, rollback/remediation notes, tests, and generated Prisma client updates.
schema_guardrail.this_doc_update: Documentation only; no schema or application code changes implied.

roadmap_not_current_state: Universal event-access guard coverage for every historical event-scoped route.
Further consolidation of older Matrix routes into the Matrix 2 / Run of Show surface.
Additional external integration infrastructure beyond snapshot-style stored metrics.
Any schema change not accompanied by a reviewed migration proposal.
